title: Anna Avanesova's Latin America Webinars | Ada Tours
description: Ada Tours webinars for travel agents and travelers: Brazil, multi-country itineraries, private journeys, and interviews with Anna Avanesova.
h1: Anna Avanesova's Webinars on Latin America
lead: Where should you begin a journey through Brazil, and how can you combine several countries in one trip? In these recorded sessions, Anna shares her knowledge of the region, explores destinations, and brings potential itineraries to life.

sections.heading: Choose a webinar that suits your plans
paragraphsMarkdown: For a first introduction, start with the [2026 overview of Latin America](#webinar-2026). If you'd like to combine [Brazil](/brazil/), [Argentina](/argentina/), [Bolivia](/bolivia/), [Chile](/chile/) and [Peru](/peru/), watch the [five-country webinar](#webinar-2018). The [live session from Rio](#webinar-2015) introduces Ada Tours' approach to tailor-made travel.

These recordings are useful both for travel agents advising clients and for travelers deciding which countries to visit. Each listing includes the topic, date and a link to the session materials on Profi.Travel.

sections.heading: Anna's first-hand experience and the Ada Tours team
paragraphsMarkdown: [Anna Avanesova](/team/anna-avanesova/) explored Latin America long before founding Ada Tours. Today she leads the company and works on complex private itineraries, VIP travel, group trips and requests from overseas tour operators.

In her webinars, that experience helps connect destinations with individual interests: who might enjoy an extended journey through several countries, and who might prefer to spend longer in one region. Anna discusses her approach in more detail in the [Price of Business interview](#anna-interview).

sections.heading: Turn an inspiring idea into a journey
paragraphsMarkdown: Each recording retains its original broadcast date. The destinations and ideas can help you choose an itinerary; we discuss current services and pricing for your specific travel dates. Start with [Brazil tours](/brazil/tour/) and [multi-country journeys](/multi-country/).

Send us your preferences, travel dates, number of travelers and accommodation requirements. If you're planning for a client, see our [travel agents section](/dmc/travel-agencies/) for what to include in your initial inquiry and how we work with partners.

sourcesIntro: Anna hosts the sessions and Ada Tours is the organizer. Open the relevant webinar page on Profi.Travel to explore its agenda and materials.

sourceEntries.title: Discover Latin America with Ada Tours
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: An introduction to Latin America, from Brazil's cities and natural landscapes to Patagonia, the Andes and the Galápagos Islands. Anna explores destinations that can help shape a journey around each traveler's interests.

sourceEntries.title: Fall in Love with Latin America
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: Carnival and New Year in Rio, the Amazon rainforest, Patagonian glaciers and tropical islands. This session shows the remarkable range of experiences available across the region.

sourceEntries.title: Brazil and Latin America: A Journey Within
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: Anna discusses travel through the lens of personal experiences and interests. The focus is on places that inspire people to explore and on the emotional side of discovering Latin America.

sourceEntries.title: Brazil and Latin America
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: New Year and Carnival in Rio, Brazilian beaches and onward travel in Central America. Anna introduces destinations and activities worth considering when planning a trip.

sourceEntries.title: Five Latin American Countries in One Journey
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: A session about [Brazil](/brazil/), [Argentina](/argentina/), [Bolivia](/bolivia/), [Chile](/chile/) and [Peru](/peru/). Topics include Rio Carnival, Iguazu Falls, Buenos Aires, the Atacama Desert, Uyuni, Patagonia and Peru.

sourceEntries.title: Private Travel: Live from Rio
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: Speaking from Rio de Janeiro, Anna introduces Ada Tours and explains private journeys through Brazil and neighboring countries. The session covers choosing destinations, activities and excursions.
sourceEntries.linkLabel: View the live session from Rio

sourceEntries.title: Travel in Latin America: An Interview with Anna
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: A conversation with Kevin Price about how Anna's own travels became the foundation of her work with guests. The English-language article on The Times USA includes an audio recording of the Price of Business Show.

faqHeading: Frequently asked questions about Ada Tours webinars

faq.question: Who are Anna Avanesova's webinars for?
faq.answerMarkdown: Primarily for travel agents and tour operators planning Latin American itineraries. Independent travelers will also find inspiration: the sessions introduce destinations and help them articulate what they want from their own trip.

faq.question: Where can I find a webinar and its agenda?
faq.answerMarkdown: Each listing links to the relevant session on Profi.Travel, with the topic, date, presenter and agenda. Anna's separate interview is available on The Times USA.

faq.question: Can I book an itinerary featured in an older webinar?
faq.answerMarkdown: Send us the webinar topic and a list of places that caught your interest. We'll plan the itinerary around your dates and requirements; services, accommodation and pricing are agreed when preparing a proposal. Current options appear in our [tour catalog](/tours/).

faq.question: What should I send Ada Tours after watching?
faq.answerMarkdown: Share your dates or date range, number of travelers, countries of interest, accommodation preferences and budget. Travel agents can also include client requirements and essential itinerary stops; the process is described in our [travel agents section](/dmc/travel-agencies/).

finalCta.title: Which destinations would you like to combine?
finalCta.text: Send us your idea, travel dates and preferences. The Ada Tours team can turn your inspiration into a travel itinerary.
finalCta.label: Discuss your itinerary
